verdict.rationale: Evidence shows general dispute-management and refund tools (list_disputes, accept_dispute_claim, create_refund) and standard PayPal fee/webhook docs, but nothing documents fraud, liability, or chargeback allocation specifically for agent-initiated transactions (e.g., who bears risk when a delegated token or AI agent purchase is disputed). The delegated-token docs mention tokens are 'bound to your merchant ID' but stop short of stating liability shift or chargeback rules for agent-driven checkouts.
